CustomField.description: Average square footage covered by one sod roll for this community. Used in DQC.Sod_Rolls_Expected__c formula to calculate expected roll count at delivery (WO.Sod_Square_Footage__c / Avg_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c). Default is 9 SF per roll if blank. This is specific to sod rolls. Do not confuse with Coverage_Per_Bale__c which is for pine straw bales — these are separate materials with separate coverage rates.
CustomField.label: Avg Sod Roll Coverage (SF)
